     root is `wiki/`, every other .md under it is an OKF concept document, and this

     available before opening anything.

     Per OKF §8 an index carries no frontmatter, except that the bundle-root index MAY
     declare `okf_version` — which is why that one key above is the only one here.

     Two deliberate local choices, both permitted by the spec:
       - Links are plain relative paths, not bundle-absolute (`/…`). The spec supports
         both; relative keeps pages readable in Obsidian and any plain markdown editor,
         which is a standing workspace principle.
       - History lives in `log/<date>.md` rather than the reserved `log.md`, so parallel
         operations never write-conflict on one file. Those date files are therefore
         ordinary concept documents (each carries a `type`), not reserved log files. -->
